policy: One forecast per game: prefer earliest independently observed pregame version, otherwise earliest source-timed pregame or unknown-timing version. Known late versions excluded. Final outcomes joined by game identity. Historical missing lines are never filled from current rows.
limitations: Winner signal: NBA/CBB stored predicted winner; NFL/MLB highest win probability; CFB projected-margin sign; World Cup three-way most likely outcome.
Spread accuracy follows the side implied by projected home margin versus the stored market handicap. It is not necessarily a published betting recommendation or verified ROI.
NBA/CBB predicted handicaps are negated to obtain home margins. NFL/CFB projections already represent home margins. Market lines are home handicaps.
MLB full-game run-line forecasts, World Cup handicaps and CFB market lines are unavailable in the connected prediction sources; no spread performance is invented.

CFB is a research population and is reported separately. Unknown timing and reused model versions limit historical claims. Independently observed means retained before kickoff, not proof of user exposure.
Only completed reporting dates are included; unfinished games on those dates remain unresolved. Winner ties and spread pushes are excluded from hit-rate denominators.
